protocol.evaluation_unit: exact event ID after the calibration boundary
protocol.uncertainty_unit: seed; 95% bootstrap interval across held-out seeds
protocol.evidence_integrity_rule: Each reference must exist in that case, share an entity with its prediction, and be no later than the predicted event. This checks structural support, not causal sufficiency.

limitations: Seeds 101 onward are unseen generator seeds, not independently collected real-world cases.
Labels are generated from known synthetic mechanisms and are not expert judgments.
Only deterministic variant C is available in this run; it does not compare REFLEX with an agent baseline.
Evidence integrity is an entity/time consistency check and does not establish that evidence is causally sufficient.
